text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear simple topic sentences: \"To begin with,\" \"Next,\" \"Finally,\" \"In conclusion\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay uses a clear paragraph structure and transitions that make its overall progression easy to follow."},{"evidence":"\"my talent is roaring like a lion\"; \"My other talent is hoola-hooping with my arms\"","quality":"specificity","description":"The essay gives concrete examples of talents and skills rather than staying abstract."},{"evidence":"\"I enjoy drawing because i can draw what i'm feeling\"; \"I would scare my friends and it's funny\"","quality":"explanatory detail","description":"The essay adds brief reasons and explanations that help develop each point."},{"evidence":"\"I use my legs and ball up my fist for more movement\"; \"I only use my arms and legs for more movement\"","quality":"sentence clarity","description":"The sentences are generally easier to interpret and less tangled than in the other essay."},{"evidence":"\"I believe that everyone has a talent and skill\"; \"Don't be afraid to share your talent\"","quality":"coherence","description":"The conclusion returns to the main idea in a way that feels consistent with the rest of the essay."}]}
